verdict.rationale: WooCommerce is explicitly described as 'the open-source commerce platform for WordPress' giving 'full control,' and it is GPL-licensed with source hosted publicly (evidenced by the wordpress.org plugin registry listing active installs of the open plugin). This confirms both open licensing and public source availability that an AI-native reader could inspect. Missing for 10: explicit citation of the GPL license text or GitHub source repo link in the evidence pack, and independent confirmation of license terms beyond the marketing claim.
